column1: Stir together the olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, rosemary, thyme and oregano in a glass dish.
Add the chicken, turn to coat, cover and refrigerate at least 2–3 hours.
Heat a grill to high and lightly oil the grates.
Remove the chicken from the marinade (discard the marinade) and grill about 15 minutes per side, less for smaller pieces, until the juices run clear and it reaches 165°F (74°C) near the bone.
Serve with lemon wedges if you like.
